shield.name: Security shield
shield.level.1.title: Basic
shield.level.2.title: Sovereign digital
shield.level.3.title: Hardware enclave
shield.level.1.body: Your password never leaves your device (OPAQUE + Argon2id). Add a passkey or ROUT Card for hardware protection.
shield.level.2.body: Passkey linked: sign in with biometrics or a PIN, resistant to phishing.
shield.level.3.body: ROUT Card linked: your key lives in a chip you hold yourself.
shield.unknown.title: Status unknown
shield.unknown.body: We couldn't check your security right now. Please try again later.
shield.ladder.label: Security levels
shield.factors.label: Your factors
shield.factor.passkey.synced: Passkey synced through your password manager
shield.factor.passkey.mixed: Passkeys on one device and synced
shield.factor.card.unknown: Card status could not be checked
shield.notice.card_frozen: Card temporarily frozen. Hardware enclave is suspended until you unfreeze the card.
shield.notice.card_needs_passkey: Your ROUT Card is active. Add a passkey to reach Hardware enclave.
shield.notice.card_status_unknown: Your ROUT Card status could not be checked, so we don't show a higher level.
shield.change.down.passkey_removed: Your shield is now at {{level}} because your passkey was removed.
shield.change.down.card_frozen: Your shield is now at {{level}} because your card is temporarily frozen.
shield.change.down.card_removed: Your shield is now at {{level}} because your ROUT Card is no longer active.
shield.change.down.factor_removed: Your shield is now at {{level}} because a security factor was removed.
shield.info: The shield is information for you only. It never decides access and nobody else sees it.
